why: The answer depends on the cohesion-derived tensile strength of water holding the transpiration-pull column intact, and no chapter in the supplied list teaches water transport.
note: Expected chapter: 'Transport in Plants' (NCERT Class 11, Ch 11), which teaches cohesion, adhesion, tensile strength and the cohesion-tension/transpiration-pull model. It is absent from the supplied 32-chapter Biology taxonomy; 'Anatomy of Flowering Plants' covers xylem as a tissue but not the ascent of sap.
